title: Course frontmatter
description: Schema for the YAML frontmatter of a course Markdown file. The body of the file must additionally contain the six required sections listed in README.md — this schema covers only the structured, filterable/navigable fields.

id.description: Stable unique identifier for the course. Never reuse or change once published.

slug.description: URL-friendly identifier, used for the course's page path.

summary.description: One or two sentence teaser shown in catalogue/list views.

audience.description: Top-level site section(s) the course appears under. Drives the primary nav split.

pillar.description: Single training pillar from the Lunis taxonomy. Drives the nav submenu under each audience. Taxonomy is open-ended for now — values aren't yet constrained to a fixed enum.

clientType.description: Independent filter tag, separate from audience.

businessFunction.description: Independent filter tag. Open-ended list — see README.md for the current draft set.

image.description: URL or repo-relative path to the course's promotional image.

active.description: Whether the course should appear in the published catalogue.
